cohort: The study included 3208 children aged 12-35 months old from the Ethiopian Demographic Health Survey 2019.
finding: The prevalence of zero-dose vaccination status among children aged 12-35 months was 16.3%, with identified hotspots in Afar, Somalia, and the south nations region, where home delivery and poor wealth index were significant positive determinants.
mod_finding: Giving birth at home was identified as a significant determinant, showing the highest positive effect on zero-dose vaccination status in Afar, Somalia, and Tigray regions.
